goal: Certified FIT bitstream and real validated Opt4 FPGA experiments; runtime unavailability never stops RTL iteration
selection_rules: Preserve current live whole synthesis; reuse validated DCP/stage outputs
Read actual DUT and complete post-opt resource reports; classify FIT/NOT FIT honestly
Choose structurally significant measured/proven module gains per verification time; no unproved stacking
Do not launch another whole merely for a small selector gain when capacity shortfall remains massive; prepare larger combinations first
On FIT immediately implement, timing, DRC, bitstream and certify; failed physical implementation requires targeted diagnosis/recovery
One new whole-DUT synthesis at a time, eight ordinary jobs, at most two memory/load-gated light auxiliaries
Proof timeout/tool failure/no gain marks only that candidate failed; other candidates and next AI round continue
